items.text: Elcogen (priority stack):* No new company news in the window — direct check of elcogen.com/category/news confirms the latest item remains the Sept 21, 2026 multi-year cooperation agreement with Metrosert on solid oxide technology testing. No capacity-expansion, product-release, or new partnership announcement found for the last 24-48h.

Topsoe (priority stack):* No new company news in the window — direct check of topsoe.com/news shows the most recent substantive items remain the H1 2026 half-year results (challenging market, DKK ~4.4bn special-items charge) and the upward 2026 outlook revision, both already logged. No new SOEC/SOFC test result, factory milestone, or partnership identified.

Rotating benchmark-company dedicated searches (this cycle: Convion, Hexis, SK ecoplant, Nexceris, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN), 7-day lookback:* No new items within the window. Searches surfaced only older, already-superseded history: Convion's 2024 acquisition by HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering (~€72M, Aug 2024 — not new); Hexis AG's acquisition by h2e Power (prior-year item — not new); SK ecoplant/Bloom Energy's 500 MW Preferred Distributor Agreement extension (Dec 2023 — not new); Nexceris' LEVER SOEC-scaling program and ARPA-E awards (legacy items, no 2026 update found); no substantive English or Chinese-language news located for Huatsing Power or Ningbo SOFCMAN in the lookback window.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin):* No new stack/cell-technology-specific announcements (efficiency, degradation, or manufacturing-capacity news) identified in the window beyond items already logged in prior entries.

No change* since yesterday. A direct check of bundestag.de confirms Germany's Netzpaket committee process has not produced a published final outcome; the Bundestag plenary vote remains targeted around Oct 16 (6 days out). PJM's 6 GW data-center backstop capacity procurement remains unfiled with FERC following the Sept 29 suspension order — no refiling or revised timeline located. No change on: Germany's KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration (Oct 14, 4 days out); DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E and 45V hydrogen credit status; Virginia's fuel-cell-specific 2026 Energy Plan category (5 GW target, 2029-2035) and its data-center electricity tax; EU data-centre energy/water-efficiency reporting rules; UK Ofgem's data-centre grid-connection-queue reform consultation; Ireland's data-centre grid-connection rules.
